description: This file declares the implementation of an IPC server for the Rialto project, including class definitions, method declarations, and internal data structures related to managing IPC clients, sockets, and message processing.

classes.name: ServerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IPC server instances.

classes.name: ServerImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the IPC server handling client connections, message processing, and socket management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IServer instance.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Adds a socket at the specified path and sets up connection callbacks.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Adds a client based on a socket file descriptor and sets up disconnection callback.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the server's main socket file descriptor.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for events with a specified timeout.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event message to a specified client.

methods.name: isClientConnected
methods.description: Checks if a client with the given ID is connected.

methods.name: disconnectClient
methods.description: Disconnects a client with the specified ID.

methods.name: addClientSocket
methods.description: Internal method to add a client socket and set up associated data.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to a client.

methods.name: sendErrorReply
methods.description: Sends an error reply to a client with formatted message.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles a response message from a server controller.

methods.name: populateReply
methods.description: Creates a reply message buffer for a response.

methods.name: populateErrorReply
methods.description: Creates an error reply message buffer.
